==Old Slovak==

===Etymology===
{{ety|zlw-osk|:inh|sla-pro:*do-<ety:from<*do>>|text=+|tree=+}} Cf. {{m|sk|do}}.

===Prefix===
{{head|zlw-osk|prefix}}

# {{n-g|prefix used to express the complete finishing, exhaustion, or cessation of an action}}: [[finish]], [[out]]
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|bojovať<t:to fight>|dobojovať<t:to finish fighting/end a struggle>}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|žať<t:to reap/harvest>|dožať<t:to finish reaping/finish the harvest>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate a large or full measure of an action, often resulting in damage or exhaustion}}: [[all over]], [[up]]
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|hrýzť<t:to bite>|dohrýzť<t:to bite all over/maul>}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|štípať<t:to sting/pinch>|doštípať<t:to sting all over>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate movement reaching a specific boundary in space}}: [[to]], [[towards]], [[as far as]]
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|-behnúť<t:to run>|dobehnúť<t:to reach/arrive by running>}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|siahnuť<t:to reach for>|dosiahnuť<t:to reach/attain>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate the additional performance of a missing part of an action to achieve completeness}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|platiť<t:to pay>|doplatiť<t:to pay the balance/pay extra>}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|variť<t:to cook>|dovariť<t:to finish cooking/cook the rest>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used with reflexive verbs to indicate the successful achievement of a goal or state through effort}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|žiť<t:to live>|dožiť<alt:dožiť sa>|t2=to live to see/reach a certain age}}
#: {{prefixusex|zlw-osk|volať<t:to call>|dovolať<alt:dovolať sa>|t2=to succesfully summon by voice}}

====Derived terms====
{{prefixsee|zlw-osk}}

====Descendants====
* {{desc|sk|do-}}

==Slovak==

===Etymology===
{{ety|sk|:inh|zlw-osk:do-|etydate=14th century|text=+|tree=+}}<ref>{{R:sk:Králik||128}}</ref> Cf. {{m|sk|do}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{sk-IPA}}

===Prefix===
{{head|sk|prefix}}

# {{n-g|prefix used to express the complete finishing, exhaustion, or cessation of an action}}: [[finish]], [[out]]
#: {{prefixusex|sk|čítať<t:to read>|dočítať<t:to finish reading>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|jesť<t:to eat>|dojesť<t:to finish eating/eat up>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate a large or full measure of an action, often resulting in damage or exhaustion}}: [[all over]], [[up]]
#: {{prefixusex|sk|hrýzť<t:to bite>|dohrýzť<t:to bite all over/maul>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|štípať<t:to sting/pinch>|doštípať<t:to sting all over>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate movement reaching a specific boundary in space}}: [[to]], [[towards]], [[as far as]]
#: {{prefixusex|sk|-behnúť<t:to run>|dobehnúť<t:to reach/arrive by running>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|hnať<t:to drive/chase>|dohnať<t:to drive as far as/to a certain place>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|siahnuť<t:to reach for>|dosiahnuť<t:to reach/attain>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used to indicate the additional performance of a missing part of an action to achieve completeness}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|kúpiť<t:to buy>|dokúpiť<t:to buy more/buy the remainder>}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|soliť<t:to salt>|dosoliť<t:to add more salt>}}
# {{n-g|prefix used with reflexive verbs to indicate the successful achievement of a goal or state through effort}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|žiť<t:to live>|dožiť<alt:dožiť sa>|t2=to live to see/reach a certain age}}
#: {{prefixusex|sk|volať<t:to call>|dovolať<alt:dovolať sa>|t2=to reach someone by phone/get through to someone}}

====Derived terms====
{{prefixsee|sk}}

##: {{prefixusex|sl|téči|t1=to run|dotéči|t2=to catch up with}}
